what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Hybrid: in person at the Middle School or on Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83227847126, Meeting ID 832 2784 7126); broadcast later on local access cable, Facebook and YouTube.

items.agenda_line: 14. Executive Session - pursuant to Massachusetts General
items.why_it_matters: The committee may close the session under Chapter 30A Section 21(a)(1) to discuss complaints brought against a public officer, employee, staff member or individual (an Open Meeting Law complaint, Timothy Loughlin), and the public cannot attend that part.
The committee reviews and approves the bills paid by the district in this period, a total of $476,295.64 as printed.
The committee is to discuss an update on the district's transport vans, a service and equipment matter for families.
The committee is to discuss how its own roles and responsibilities are defined.

items.agenda_line: a. High Level Discussion of FY28 Budget
items.why_it_matters: The committee is to hold an early, high-level discussion of the school budget for fiscal year 2028.

items.agenda_line: b. Appointment of Amanda Gilman as MASC
items.why_it_matters: This is listed as an action item to appoint a member as the committee's delegate to the Massachusetts Association of School Committees.
